note: Crawford County Conservation Board park 4 mi west of Dow City on 11-acre Stern Lake. The main campground is Modern Hill; the Beach campground sits by the swimming beach; plus 4 primitive cabins. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 85 sites in four areas, first-come self-registration with no reservations, showers and dump, $17 electric / $12 non-electric (fees left as stored, $17). Season written mid-April through October (04-15/10-31). Waterfront lead: lakefront looks unsupported; downgrade to not waterfront proposed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront -> not waterfront; no evidence for an on-water or view call): the county's page gives four areas (Modern Hill 55, Tent Hill 10, Beach campground 10, boat ramp area 4) and no site map; stored waterfront_evidence is empty. On NAIP the lake is ~11 acres (the county's figure, so a lake, not a pond). The largest loop west of the lake (centre ~41.9380,-95.5926, likely Modern Hill) sits in forest ~200 m from the water. The east shore carries a park drive along the water with a tree belt on the lake side; the clearings east of it are ~60-150 m back behind the drive. The Beach campground's 10 sites sit behind the swimming beach, which is day use (AWH 2026-11-01, Leafy Oaks), so they cannot be on-water; a view from them is not shown by any official photo. The 4 boat-ramp sites cannot be located (a dock and gravel turnaround on the west shore near 41.9376,-95.5896 is the likely ramp; the ramp is day use). None of the four official campground photos shows the lake. No pads were seen within a pad-depth of open shore, so per the 2026-11-02 rule the value should go down to not waterfront.

FEES: stored $17 base is the electric rate. The county also charges '$12 per night - non-electric', but does not say which areas are non-electric or whether a motorhome may use them (Tent Hill is tents); left at $17.
FIT: no posted length limit; the county's own photos show fifth-wheel and travel-trailer rigs on the gravel loop. A 23-ft motorhome fits.
PIN: stored 41.93860,-95.59056 is in woods between the west loop and the lake, ~180 m from the loop's centre; under the 250 m threshold, not changed.
PHONE: stored 712-643-5426 matches the campground page. The county conservation office is (712) 263-2748 (crawfordcounty.iowa.gov/conservation).
